title: Open-loop ring test: no structural resonance at 10 Hz
question: Is the ring mechanical — compliance between the hub/IMU and the wheels?
headline: Not supported. Three taps decay to nothing in ~400 ms with no 10 Hz peak; only 12% of spectral mass lies in the 8-13 Hz band. But the robot was held in the air, so the tyre-against-ground compliance that is actually in the loop was never excited.
